name: Kitagawa Taki
source:
The officer in charge of sexual patrols, and Jin’s immediate supervisor. She’s a kind and patient mentor to both Jin and Hiyori, and an excellent example of a skilled sex officer. Though her career has currently stagnanted, her sexual abilities and the finesse with which she carries them out means she has some of the highest ratings in the entire office. Her areas of expertise are prostitutional services and sex slavery.
